findings.desc: During B-3d39 CHK-003 test:all verify, Plan B retry HEALED all 4 timeouts (done-preflight/init-check-required-agents/lattice-cli-migration/review-pass-discard all PASS on serial retry — real-world proof Plan B works). But field-regression-cli produced a non-timeout FAIL (exit 1 at 191.8s under load); Plan B only retries TIMEOUTs, so it was not retried. field-regression-cli PASSES standalone serial (exit 0) on this branch — confirming the B-3d39 lock change is innocent and this is a pre-existing parallel-load flake (same class as B-24c3:F-001..F-004 / review-pass-discard parallel-only FAIL). Out of scope for B-3d39 (lock-reentrancy fix). Candidate for the parallel-test-architecture follow-up: consider whether Plan B retry should also cover load-induced FAILs (not just timeouts) for the known flaky set.
findings.resolvedReason: Tracked for the parallel-test-architecture follow-up. Out of scope for B-3d39 (lock-reentrancy fix). field-regression-cli passes standalone serial — confirmed innocent of the lock change. Documents the gap that Plan B retries only timeouts, not load-induced FAILs.
